tasks.title: Research provider boundaries and select the initial architecture
tasks.description: Record official provider constraints, competitor workflows, stack options, risk/permission limits, and decision rationale.
assumptions: No live provider account is authorized yet
The product is web-first and self-hostable
acceptance_criteria: Weighted stack ADR with estimated scores labeled

tasks.title: Build local mock cPanel inventory vertical slice
tasks.description: Implement fixture-backed adapter, persisted local inventory, HTTP API, durable refresh job/worker, and interactive UI.
assumptions: SQLite is local single-user PoC only
acceptance_criteria: Rows are persisted in real local DB
Error/stale states do not claim live success
Repeatable tests cover API and worker
blockers: Browser-level visual/accessibility and live provider behavior remain unverified

tasks.title: Create persistent AI rules, project documentation, diagrams, and banks
tasks.description: Create populated, linked sources of truth for AI agents, product, architecture, research, UX, security, tasks, and evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Rule entry points agree with AGENTS.md
Banks have unique IDs/cross-links and validation schema
Diagrams label target vs implemented boundaries

tasks.title: Run PostgreSQL and Redis-backed worker locally and in Compose
tasks.description: Add production-shaped persistent DB and queue with health/readiness and restart recovery.
assumptions: Docker or installable local PostgreSQL/Redis will be available in a later environment
blockers: Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis unavailable in current environment

tasks.title: Implement authentication, tenant isolation, policy enforcement, and audit
tasks.description: Enforce tenant scope and operation policy in API and worker before real credentials or provider operations.
blockers: MFA enrollment/recovery implementation and production-grade identity controls are separate follow-up work before any provider credentials

tasks.title: Verify read-only cPanel UAPI adapter against authorized sandbox
tasks.description: Validate auth, capability discovery, errors, stale data, revocation, and least privilege on an owner-authorized disposable account.
blockers: No sandbox account or scoped token provided

tasks.title: Implement idempotent installation preflight and first-admin bootstrap
tasks.description: Detect supported environment, validate storage/DB/queue, securely initialize an administrator, write an install report, and recover from interruption.

tasks.title: Validate research/decision banks and generate cross-reference checks
tasks.description: Validate structured records against versioned JSON schemas and ensure IDs, declared test references, source paths, and fixtures resolve.
assumptions: The validator supports the subset of JSON Schema keywords used by repository schemas
acceptance_criteria: Test IDs and local source/fixture paths resolve

tasks.title: Run dashboard accessibility and browser visual verification
tasks.description: Verify keyboard use, screen-reader names, contrast, responsive layout, and loading/empty/error/stale/permission states in a real browser.
assumptions: A supported browser can access the local app
acceptance_criteria: Desktop and mobile browser screenshots reviewed
Search, account selection, refresh, and API error state exercised
blockers: Shared Chrome cannot reach the isolated loopback server; Playwright Chromium download returned a truncated 0 MiB archive from the official CDN

tasks.title: Add threat-model security suite and dependency/SBOM scanning
tasks.description: Automate high-risk negative security cases and dependency/license/SBOM checks as tooling becomes available.
assumptions: No real provider credentials are added before auth and tenant isolation gates pass
acceptance_criteria: SSRF, path traversal, injection, replay, tenant, and secret exposure cases tested
Dependency audit and software bill of materials are reproducible
License gate is documented and reproducible

tasks.title: Implement MFA enrollment, verification, recovery, and notifications
tasks.description: Implement the ADR-0002 WebAuthn-first MFA policy, controlled TOTP fallback if needed, single-use recovery codes, session revocation, and recovery notifications before provider credentials are accepted.
assumptions: No provider credentials or high-impact operation is enabled before MFA/recovery controls pass
MFA secret encryption uses a separately stored key or approved secret manager
acceptance_criteria: Owners/admins enroll and verify MFA; recovery methods are bound to authenticated owner session
WebAuthn/passkeys are offered as phishing-resistant option; any OTP fallback is labeled correctly
Recovery codes are random, shown once, stored only as hashes, and consumed once
MFA recovery revokes sessions, emits audit event, and notifies verified contacts
Rate, replay, lockout, recovery, and authenticator revocation tests pass
blockers: MFA implementation, key-management design, and verified contact notification channel are not implemented
